Shared0.description: A URL whose scheme is https. Extracted unchanged from the 46 sites that stated it inline; see adcontextprotocol/adcp#8525. This is the shape adcontextprotocol/adcp#8398 asks the other seven uri patterns to reduce to.
Shared0.title: HTTPS URL

catalogRequirement.description: Required country/type pairs and optional exact catalog versions for one identifier system. Country keys prevent a false Cartesian product between countries and place types.

items.description: Canonical place classification. Registered tokens have protocol-defined meanings. Catalog-specific classifications without a registered mapping MUST use an absolute HTTPS URI controlled by the vocabulary owner; consumers compare URI types as exact opaque strings.
items.title: Geographic Place Type

system_versions.description: Optional exact catalog versions that must remain selectable. Versions are opaque strings, not ordered ranges.

description: Identifier systems and collision-safe country/type pairs the buyer must be allowed to select later.

propertyNames.description: Collision-safe identifier namespace for geographic places. Registered tokens have protocol-defined semantics. Unregistered systems MUST use an absolute HTTPS URI controlled by the catalog owner; consumers compare URI systems as exact opaque strings.
propertyNames.title: Geographic Place Identifier System

title: Geographic Place Requirement
